Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params._arm: ARM contract authorized to use the adapter.
params._liquidityAsset: Liquidity stablecoin received after Paxos settlement.

params._operator: Account that can submit queued redemptions to Paxos.
params._paxosRecipient: Paxos on-chain deposit address. Must be non-zero, otherwise reverts.

recoverExcessLiquidity().details: The recovered liquidity asset is always sent to the ARM.

params.shares: Base asset amount represented by the settled redemption.

params.newOperator: The address of the new operator.

params.newOwner: The address of the new owner.

params._paxosRecipient: Paxos deposit address for the adapter's base asset.

submitPaxosRedeem(uint256,bytes32).details: Paxos Actions should use `paxosRedemptionId` to correlate this transfer with off-chain orchestration.

params.paxosRedemptionId: Off-chain Paxos orchestration or idempotency identifier.
params.shares: Base asset amount to send. For example, `100e6` is 100 USDG/PYUSD.

PaxosRedeemClaimed(uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Emitted when settled liquidity assets are transferred to the ARM, where `100e6` is 100 USDC.

PaxosRedeemRequested(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when base assets are queued for redemption, where `100e6` is 100 tokens for 6-decimal assets.

arm().notice: ARM contract authorized to request and claim redemptions.

asset().notice: Returns the liquidity asset produced by Paxos settlement.

baseAsset().notice: Paxos-issued stablecoin supplied by the ARM.

convertToAssets(uint256).notice: Converts base stablecoin shares into expected liquidity assets at 1:1.

convertToShares(uint256).notice: Converts liquidity assets into expected base stablecoin shares at 1:1.

initialize(address,address).notice: Initialize the adapter operator and Paxos recipient.

liquidityAsset().notice: Liquidity stablecoin received after Paxos settlement.

operator().notice: The account that can request and claim withdrawals.

owner().notice: The contract owner and proxy admin.

paxosRecipient().notice: On-chain Paxos deposit address used by Actions to settle queued redemptions.

pendingShares().notice: Base asset amount queued in the adapter but not yet sent to Paxos.

recoverExcessLiquidity().notice: Recovers liquidity asset held beyond what `settlingShares` still owes, e.g. donated tokens         or a Paxos settlement that arrived after its `settlingShares` was already closed out.

redeem(uint256).notice: Claims settled USDC after Paxos Actions complete on-chain settlement to this adapter.

requestRedeem(uint256).notice: Pulls base assets from the ARM and queues them for Paxos redemption.

setOperator(address).notice: Set the account that can request and claim withdrawals.

setOwner(address).notice: Set the owner and proxy admin of the contract.

setPaxosRecipient(address).notice: Set the Paxos on-chain deposit address used for future submissions.

settlingShares().notice: Base asset amount sent to Paxos and awaiting on-chain USDC settlement.

submitPaxosRedeem(uint256,bytes32).notice: Submit queued base assets to Paxos for API-orchestrated redemption.

userdoc.notice: Adapter for redeeming Paxos-issued stablecoins through off-chain Paxos Actions with on-chain settlement.
